snippet.title: Hikki Life - Story trailer [EN]
snippet.description:
A story-driven action-adventure about a shut-in who flees people into video games. A talking cat leads him to a parallel world, where he fights in a dungeon, grows stronger, seeks his missing grandfather, and regains his memories. But the further he goes, the less that world looks like the truth.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5247960/Hikki_Life/
